son of Hadad, an Edomite of the royal family, by an Egyptian princess, the sister of Tahpenes, the queen of the Pharaoh who governed Egypt in the latter part of the reign of David

H1595.def:
1) treasury, chests?
1a) chests (of variegated cloth) (meaning uncertain)
1b) treasury
Aramaic equivalent: ge.naz (גְּנַז "treasure" H1596)

H1598.def:
1) to defend, cover, surround
1a) (Qal) to defend
1b) (Hiphil) to defend

H1599.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.10.6; also called Ginnethoi (KJV: Ginnetho) at Neh.12.4;
§ Ginnetho or Ginnethon = "gardener"
a priest among the exiles who returned with Zerubbabel and who covenanted with Nehemiah
